Subject: a painted map of the lands around a small mercenary town at night, seen from high above: the walled town with its gate at the lower left, one winding dirt road through dark woods, fields and low hills to the timbered entrance of an abandoned mine in a rocky hillside left of the middle, and on from the mine to a black chasm ringed by dead trees in the upper middle; the far lands to the top and the right sinking into darkness
